title: Google unveils the Pixel Watch 5 with a smarter Gemini and advanced health monitoring
summary: At its Made by Google event on Wednesday, Google unveiled the Pixel Watch 5 with a smarter Gemini experience, as well as advanced fitness and health monitoring. Google says the Watch 5 is 20% faster overall.
